title: Reading Drill — Shade on the School Run
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Shade on the School Run
passages.body:
**A** On warm afternoons, children queued beside a south-facing wall at Linden School. A parent group drew shadow maps at three times of day to distinguish places with no shade from places where shade appeared after dismissal.

**B** The school first moved the waiting area rather than buying equipment. Volunteers compared the photographs and found that the line could fit under a covered walkway without blocking the crossing. This gave the school an immediate trial site.

**C** The trial helped at the main gate, but it displaced some parents to a narrow pavement. Teachers asked the council to install a bench opposite the gate so people waiting for older siblings would have a safe place to sit.
